name: Davis Halloween Party 2026
information:
## Trick or Treat! Get ready for Davis Halloween Party!

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjA4MDA4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--62f69192e4eec984125c5da0a2d565d8ba0dee43/HalloweenParty2026Logo.png)
- All attendees under the age of 18 are required to be accompanied by a parent or guardian.
- Competition attendees may **appear on livestream and media**.
- If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no earlier than 20 minutes.
- Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.

**This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/), [Speedcubeshop](https://speedcubeshop.com/)**
